title: 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: Everything Changing Before You Buy (Hybrid-Only Maverick, $6 Diesel)
description:
A brand-new Silverado with new V eight engines. A Ford Maverick that will only come as a hybrid at its base trim. A Ram Hemi that came back from the dead. A Ford electric truck that was shut down. And diesel at six dollars a gallon. The truck market heading into twenty twenty-seven looks nothing like it did two years ago, and if you buy with old information, you could pay thousands more than you need to.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]
